name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/lib/motion-presets.ts'
      - 'packages/lib/motion.tsx'
      - 'packages/ui/home-hero-animated.tsx'
      - 'packages/ui/page-shell.tsx'
      - 'packages/donor/**'
      - 'packages/missionary/**'
      - 'packages/admin/**'
      - 'docs/ai/skills/anim/**'

jobs:
  codex-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Run preflight checks
        run: |
          bun run ci:preflight

      - name: Build Donor package
        run: |
          turbo run build --filter=@asym/donor

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          bun run test

      - name: Verify skills
        run: |
          bun run skills-verify

      - name: Type check
        run: |
          bun run typecheck

      - name: Lint code
        run: |
          bun run lint

      - name: Format code
        run: |
          bun run format

      - name: Notify code owner
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: pullRequests } = await github.rest.pulls.list({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              head: `${context.repo.owner}:${context.ref.replace('refs/heads/', '')}`
            });

            if (pullRequests.length > 0) {
              const prNumber = pullRequests[0].number;
              const issueUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/issues/${prNumber}`;
              
              try {
                const response = await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                  owner: context.repo.owner,
                  repo: context.repo.repo,
                  issue_number: prNumber,
                  body: '@asym-core-team Please review this PR as it contains critical UI motion changes that require attention.'
                });
                
                console.log(`Successfully commented on PR #${prNumber}`);
              } catch (error) {
                console.error('Failed to comment on PR:', error);
              }
            }
